title: BendersMC Tweaks
description: A resource pack that adds tweaks to the already existing BendersMC resource pack
body:
# BendersMC Tweaks

A collection of visual improvements, custom textures, and quality-of-life enhancements built by the community, for the community.

Whether you're a veteran bender or just starting your journey, BendersMC Tweaks makes server features easier to recognize, menus easier to navigate, and gameplay more enjoyable—all while preserving Minecraft's familiar look.

## Community Contributions

Have an idea for a texture, icon, or UI improvement? Contributions are always appreciated. Open an issue or submit a pull request to help improve the pack.
